label: def:mass-identity
title: Mass (categorical trace)
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe (quantum observable universe) and let \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0} be its recursive brane tower (recursive brane tower). Since \mathbf{C} is a R-linear rigid monoidal category, the Frobenius--Hopf object A admits a categorical trace \mathrm{tr} \colon \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A) \to R (cf. [stolz-teichner-2012]) defined by the composition:

  \mathrm{tr}(f)
  = 
  \bigl(\mathbf{1}
  \xrightarrow{ \mathrm{coev}}
  A \otimes A^{\vee}
  \xrightarrow{f \otimes \mathrm{id}}
  A \otimes A^{\vee}
  \xrightarrow{ \mathrm{ev}}
  \mathbf{1}\bigr),

where \mathrm{coev} and \mathrm{ev} are the rigidity morphisms. Let \Delta \colon A \to A \otimes A be the comultiplication and let \int_A \colon A \to \mathbf{1} be the Frobenius form.

The inertial mass of a morphism \varrho \colon \mathbf{1} \to A (a "closed cycle" in the Frobenius--Hopf object) is:

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  = 
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{tr}\bigl(
    (\int_A \otimes \mathrm{id})
    \circ \Delta
    \circ \varrho
  \bigr)
  \bigr\rVert,

where \lVert \cdot \rVert is the norm on R induced by the Frobenius pairing (Frobenius pairing). The mass measures the resistance of the Frobenius--Hopf structure to transporting the cycle \varrho through the comultiplication.

Archimedean specialisation. What follows spans the substrate wall. The pre-archimedean frobeniusMass is valued in the generic ground ring R (the Frobenius norm \lVert x\rVert_F = \langle x, x\rangle_F stays in R). The post-\tau scalarMass is the archimedean realisation R \to \mathbb{R}, x \mapsto \lVert x\rVert, obtained by evaluating the Frobenius norm at the substrate parameter q = q_0. The R \to \mathbb{R} realisation map inherently crosses the wall and cannot be made \mathbb{R}-free or generic-only. We acknowledge it here rather than splitting it off.
